text_description: Full-length runway look centered on layered, ornate brocade textures and exaggerated winter volume: the model wears a glossy emerald-green padded outer jacket with an allover gold-brown floral/foliate pattern, cut oversized through the body with substantially rounded sleeves, dropped-looking shoulders, and a large sculptural shawl/stand collar that flares outward around the neck and upper shoulders; the jacket is worn open, exposing a rust, copper, and burgundy patterned wrap-style tailored top beneath, with a V-shaped neckline, visible collar/lapel edges, and overlapping front panels that extend to the upper thigh like a long jacket or tunic. The lower body is a dark olive-brown, close-cut knee-length skirt with dense raised texture and small reflective embellishment-like specks, creating a heavy, nubby surface contrast against the smoother patterned upper layers. Styling continues with scrunched grey patterned socks or leg warmers rising above dark oxblood-brown ankle footwear, plus a visible bright cobalt-blue sock band on one lower leg. The palette is rich and autumnal—emerald, rust, copper, olive, brown, burgundy, gold, grey, and a small electric-blue accent—with the overall silhouette mixing a voluminous padded upper body, elongated wrapped mid-layer, and narrow textured skirt.
key_elements: rust/copper patterned wrap-style tunic or jacket underneath
grey patterned scrunched socks or leg warmers
uncertainty_notes: Exact fabric content and closures are not visible
Footwear shape and sock layering are partially obscured by motion and shadow
